ns2:section.sectionText: *Students must register for the Lecture and one Discussion section. Priority for registration is given to ADV and CS+ADV majors who have met the pre-requisites and whose graduation date is Spring 2026 or earlier. The course will not likely open outside of these guidelines. Students who have completed ADV 460 should not register for ADV 360. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Computer Science & Advertising major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
